scope: Reviewed Issues claims only, not full six-source reconciliation.

rows.conflict: Read creation authority differs tutorial write prerequisite and metadata mutation authority.
rows.requirement: Bind enabled-issues/read access separately from label/assignee/project/field permissions; preview target and each metadata mutation.
rows.negative_test: Read-only creation cannot imply label/Project authority;404 cannot count compliant absence.

rows.conflict: Templates/form text prefilling and nonblocking duplicate hints differ field state/validated intake.
rows.requirement: Validate actual submitted content and exact template/form schema; distinguish organization field assignment and independently audited duplicate equivalence.
rows.negative_test: Template insertion or duplicate suggestion cannot certify required field truth or prevent duplicate creation.

rows.conflict: Issue boolean nesting/ownership limits and field grammar differ Projects automation scope.
rows.requirement: Parameterize surface/platform/version, grouping/qualifiers and unsupported syntax; preserve complete declared inventory outside query results.
rows.negative_test: Unsupported adapter syntax or ambiguous ownership OR grouping cannot silently pass scope verification.

rows.conflict: Review/status predicates and shared URLs describe current accessible display, not frozen accepted evidence.
rows.requirement: Resolve required checks/reviews, exact head/target, permissions, freshness and pagination; persist independently evaluated criterion evidence.
rows.negative_test: status:success without required-check completeness or identical URL with different access cannot certify acceptance.

rows.conflict: Removable history, code snippet, discussion copy and clone do not establish immutable source or retained full history.
rows.requirement: Preserve authorized digests/revision/actor/time and exact source/destination plus retained metadata map; distinguish new identity from transfer.
rows.negative_test: Snippet or edit-history UI cannot substitute immutable audit; copied issue cannot claim all discussion history.

rows.conflict: AI suggestions/summaries/assignment differ verified live execution and authoritative decisions.
rows.requirement: Record authorized action/version/input scope/run handle/output and independent review; retain human-required acceptance and no automatic installation.
rows.negative_test: Label, assignment or generated summary cannot prove live cloud handoff, correctness or prior adopted decision.

rows.conflict: Tutorial repository creation and example identity differ existing function-owned polyrepo architecture.
rows.requirement: Parameterize repository function/ownership/access and reuse existing homes; retain provenance separately from deployable contacts/names.
rows.negative_test: Tutorial Project Octocat cannot trigger unrelated rename/monorepo restructuring or invented contacts.

rows.conflict: Broad forms/discussion-label/dependency prose conflicts with detailed cloud qualifications.
rows.requirement: Retain broad and detailed claim identities; use conservative unknown for disputed capability until exact version/behavior independently verified.
rows.negative_test: Parent GHES wildcard must not manufacture support for cloud-only child capability.

rows.conflict: Default definitions and tutorial labels do not establish desired assignment or universally adopted policy.
rows.requirement: Separate platform defaults, current configured definitions, assigned values and explicit local obligation strength.
rows.negative_test: Existing Priority field/good-first-issue label cannot certify required value or safe newcomer task.

limitations: Negative tests are proposals, not executed new bindings.
Claim identity checks do not certify mapping equivalence or independent omission completeness.
No policy adoption, native changes or rights clearance.
